in_marathi.name: Sakharam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Friendship
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sakharam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sakharam is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, who is also known as Kartikeya. He is the god of war, peace, and victory, and is often depicted as the god of friendship and loyalty. He is also considered a god of protection and is invoked to remove obstacles and to grant success.
